arguments.command:
python -c "
import sys
sys.argv = ['glom', '--spec-format=python-full', 'value']

from face import Command, PosArgSpec
from glom.cli import glom_cli

posargs = PosArgSpec(str, max_count=2, display={'label': '[spec [target]]'})
cmd = Command(glom_cli, posargs=posargs)
cmd.add('--spec-format', str, missing='python', doc='format')

parsed = cmd.parse(sys.argv[1:])
print('flags:', parsed.flags)
print('posargs:', parsed.posargs)
"
